comparison.objective: Select the fitting pin and seat it fully in a fixture hole; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Part discrimination, arm-to-arm relay and peg insertion versus recessed hex engagement, bounded torque, collar manipulation and repeated response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct pin must reach the hole floor upright and remain still; candidate requires locked adjustment plus two force- and travel-compliant impacts.
comparison.reason: Fine alignment is shared only as a generic primitive; the functional abilities and outcomes are different.
